I’ve tried to publish a survey again and run into the same problem (publishing takes a long time and I finally get am error message that I should try again). But I think I might know what the problem is.

We are running quite a big study (more than 300 participants participating in 100+ sessions per survey). It seems like the process still keeps going after the error message because later in the activities overview I see the changed activity as published.

I thought maybe this information is of interest to you.

All the best,
